blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY — US President Donald Trump drew criticism from activists, Indigenous peoples’ groups, and students who gathered at Igorot Park on Monday afternoon, Nov. 16, to protest his scheduled visit to the Philippines. The protesters also denounced the Pax Silica initiative and condemned the dispersal of a protest caravan and the arrest of its participants in Muntinlupa City a day earlier. “Trump, the war criminal, is not welcome in this country,” activist Joel Capulong said. The Nov. 15 arrests involved students and faculty members of the University of the Philippines Los Baños. Protesters also raised concerns over the reported deployment […]...
